notes.title: Update notes for Dec 5
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

This release improves loading performance to reduce visual stutters when exploring. I hope you enjoy smooth experience :)

Ryan

notes.title: Improved Camera and a World Map... Oh My!
notes.content:
You guys asked and I listened. The most common complaints about the game were the camera and the lack of world map. The lastest update has addressed these issues and I hope you think this makes the game more fun. Thanks for your help making the game better. Please keep the feedback coming!

Here are some details about the changes (version 1.0.14 will be displayed in the lower left corner of the title screen):


 A world map is now available. It's an item you'll need to find in the world but it becomes available very early in the game.
 Full manual controls are now availble if you want to control the camera yourself. Please see the Gameplay section of the Settings menu to change the camera controls.
 I've improved the camera movement regardless of what type of camera you are using (manual or automatic) to give you a clearer view of the player if they are blocked by terrain.


I hope like the changes. Any comments or questions, feel free to let me know! The fastest way to contact me is through Discord but I'll repsond wherever you want to leave a comment.

Thanks for being helpful, everyone!
Ryan

notes.title: Update notes for Dec 3
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

This build has the following changes:

- Improved camera when player is blocked by terrain
- Added an option for full manual camera control
- A world map is now available
- Bug fixes

Have fun!
Ryan

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 13
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this release has improved camera controls for the mouse. I also fixed a bug where regions of the world do not load properly after completing the game. Thanks for pointing these issues out to me!

Ryan

notes.title: Night Stones is now FUNDED on Kickstarter!!! 🎉
notes.content:
Thank You!
I'm thrilled to share that thanks to all of you, our Kickstarter campaign has been successfully funded!

My dream open-world adventure game is one step closer to reality. I'm deeply moved and grateful to have such a supportive community following the development of the game. Your support is shaping the world of Night Stones into something truly special.

What's Next?
Moving forward, I'm committed to keeping you updated with all the developments. Expect continued regular updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes content as I pour my heart out into creating a game that I hope you'll love.

Alpha Testing - Soon!
I'm hard at work on the first alpha demo, which will be made available exclusively for the Kickstarter backers on the Alpha Stone tier and up. I can't wait to get amazing feedback from all of you!

You Rule
Once again, thank you for being the best part of Night Stones. Your support means the world to me, and I can't wait to continue this adventure together.

Until next time,
Ryan
